parameters.content:
## 1. Read & build messages
Every few hours (or Test Manually): load settings, read the sheet, classify each row and fill the message templates.

## 2. Send by email & SMS
Sends on whichever channel it can reach; skips invalid contacts.

## 3. Log & handle failures
Write status back; alert the owner if a send fails.

## 4. Daily owner digest
Summary of everything sent, by email and Slack.

## Appointment Lifecycle — PRO (Email + SMS)

Runs through the day, reads your appointments from Google Sheets, and sends the right message at the right time — confirmations, multi-touch reminders, no-show win-backs and review requests — by email and/or SMS. Timezone-aware, validates contacts, routes unhappy clients to private feedback, alerts you if a message fails, and emails you a summary of every run.

**Who's it for:** dental, salon, clinic, spa and other appointment businesses (and their agencies).

## How it works
1. Runs every few hours (near-instant confirmations) — or Test Manually.
2. Reads appointments, timezone-aware, and works out each row's stage.
3. Sends your editable message by email and/or SMS (skips anyone it can't reach).
4. Writes status back so nothing repeats, and emails/Slacks you a summary.

## Setup
1. Connect Google Sheets + Gmail (Twilio and Slack optional).
2. Create a Sheet named 'Appointments' with columns: AppointmentID (unique), Name, Email, Phone, AppointmentDate (YYYY-MM-DD), Status, Channel, LastContacted.
3. Status values: new, confirmed, completed, no-show, cancelled.
4. In Configuration set your timezone, business info, links, reminder days and message templates.
5. Pick your sheet in both Google Sheets nodes, run Test Manually, then activate.
Not using SMS or Slack? Delete those nodes.
